Question: A student recorded the exact percentage frequency distribution for a set of measurements, as shown below. However, the student neglected to indicate \(N,\) the total number of measurements. What is the smallest possible value of \(N?\) \[\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \text{measured value} & \text{percent frequency}\\ \hline 0 & 12.5\\ \hline 1 & 0\\ \hline 2 & 50\\ \hline 3 & 25\\ \hline 4 & 12.5\\ \hline & 100\\ \hline\end{array}\]
